title: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
summary: A technical investigation revealing that Windows 11's built-in Weather application consumes over 1 GB of RAM, which is excessive for a simple weather widget. The article explores why this occurs, likely due to the app being built on WebView2/Edge components.
problem_solved: Highlights Windows 11's resource inefficiency in its bundled apps, which can impact system performance on lower-end hardware.
why_valuable: Provides practical insights for users looking to optimize Windows 11 system resources by identifying unnecessary background processes consuming excessive memory.
